requirements.statement: Establish session token sizing without assuming a minimum cost per run or event.
One authenticated hand-off atomically closes and opens a linked orchestration, with idempotent crash recovery and reserved close capacity.
Runner continuation automatically rolls over at independent registration, report and event boundaries without an owner action or user-facing capacity refusal.
Persist bounded resume state continuously and generate linked resume packets from sealed project records after restart.
Prove independent boundaries, exact replay, reserved close, repeated past-cap operation, rollback and abrupt process exit with fast tests.
